title: Ak Ultimate Edition
description: A comprehensive server-side utility combining a high-performance Lag Machine Finder (redstone, pistons, entity tracking) with a client brand Anti-Cheat detector and custom Temp-Ban manager.
body:
# ⚡ Ak Ultimate Edition
A comprehensive, lightweight, and high-performance administration plugin combining **Lag Machine Finder** capabilities, client brand-based **Anti-Cheat detection**, and an **Advanced Temp-Ban** system. Optimized natively for Minecraft/Paper **1.21.11**.

Developed with passion by **Akash Dev**.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

### 🔍 1. Lag Machine Finder
Keep your server running at a solid 20 TPS! Ak Ultimate Edition tracks lag-inducing sources in real-time using a memory-safe, bucketed sliding window.
*   **Redstone Activity Tracker**: Monitored via a sliding window (default 10s) to detect high-frequency redstone clocks.
*   **Piston Spam Detector**: Detects rapid piston extensions/retractions that drop server performance.
*   **Entity Clustering Monitor**: Easily spot chunks loaded with excessive entities (mobs, items, vehicles).
*   **Chunk Control Commands**: Quickly `/lagfinder purge` (remove all entities except players) or `/lagfinder freeze` (replace laggy redstone lines/pistons with air) in target chunks.

### 🚫 2. Cheat Brand Detector (Anti-Cheat)
Bans players using forbidden cheat clients automatically before they can disrupt your server.
*   **Client Brand Analysis**: Intercepts client brand packets (on `minecraft:brand`) when players connect.
*   **Auto Temp-Ban**: Instantly bans players for **3 days** if they connect with known blacklisted clients (e.g. Wurst, Meteor, LiquidBounce, Impact, etc.).
*   **Public Announcements**: Automatically broadcasts a public message in server chat naming the player and the cheat client brand they used, warning potential rule-breakers.

### 🔨 3. Temp-Ban Manager
An administrator-focused tool to quickly execute temp-bans.
*   Command: `/aktempban <player> <days> [reason]`
*   Generates a stylized kick screen containing the ban reason, expiration duration, and a link to your Discord appeal server.
*   Broadcasts a custom announcement message server-wide.

---

## 📜 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/lagfinder scan` | Scans loaded chunks and displays active lag sources. | `aklagfinder.admin` | OP |
| `/lagfinder chunks` | Lists the top 10 chunks sorted by recent redstone/piston activity. | `aklagfinder.admin` | OP |
| `/lagfinder entities` | Lists the top 10 loaded chunks sorted by entity count. | `aklagfinder.admin` | OP |
| `/lagfinder tp <x> <z> [world]` | Teleports to the center of the specified chunk safely (at the highest block). | `aklagfinder.admin` | OP |
| `/lagfinder purge <x> <z> [world]`| Purges all entities (except players) in the specified chunk. | `aklagfinder.admin` | OP |
| `/lagfinder freeze <x> <z> [world]`| Freezes redstone/pistons in the chunk (replaces configured blocks with air). | `aklagfinder.admin` | OP |
| `/aktempban <player> <days> [reason]`| Temporarily bans a player for a specified number of days and broadcasts it. | `aklagfinder.tempban`| OP |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)
The plugin is highly customizable. You can adjust:
*   Blacklisted client brand lists.
*   Lag thresholds for warnings and notification rates.
*   Automatic and manual temp-ban durations and message screens.
*   Specific materials to target for removal when freezing a chunk.
